acting.objective: Find out whether the evening's work is really finished.
acting.subtext: I expect another problem, but want to believe I can go home.
acting.emotion_start: Tired skepticism, attentive eyes; no fixed smile.
acting.emotion_end: Quiet, surprised relief, a small sincere smile.
acting.delivery: First question tentative and rising; a small breath, then warm relief. Do not shout or read like an announcer.
acting.gesture: One glance at the phone, then loosen shoulders as the answer lands.
acting.listener: Look toward the off-camera colleague while listening; do not stare motionlessly at the lens.
acting.start: Medium shot, phone in right hand at waist, gaze toward colleague.
acting.action: Glance down, look back, ask the questions, exhale and finish the last sentence.
acting.end: Phone remains in the same hand; shoulders relaxed, gaze on colleague.
acting.hold: Keep the relieved reaction readable for half a second after the line; no new action.
acting.camera: One steady eye-level smartphone shot, natural light, no zoom or cut.
